messages:
maya (Design): quick sync on the Settings form patterns: required field signals, multi-step validation, and the team-delete modal copy. want a single doc to hand to devs.
ben (PM): lay out the patterns and tradeoffs please.
claire (DevEx): accessibility first: screen reader announcements for required + live region handling for validation.
omar (Eng): low variance pls. we can support inline errors or a summary; cost is in edge-case focus management.
maya (Design): pattern 1 (compact lists): visible asterisk + sr-only 'required' text after label; aria-required on inputs. pattern 2 (long forms): small legend at top that explains '*' = Required, so we avoid clutter.
maya (Design): proposed compact label example: Label: Email * [sr-only: required]. keeps visual density down but announces to SRs.
ben (PM): for wizards, users miss inline errors if scrolled. propose an error-summary at top of step with links/anchors to fields and focus move to first invalid field.
claire (DevEx): yes. summary should be keyboard tabbable, update via aria-live, and link-click should focus the target. also ensure screen readers hear the summary when it appears.
omar (Eng): implementation note: add data-error-id attrs and single focus handler. avoid re-rendering entire form on every validation tick to keep perf good.
maya (Design): delete-team copy options: 'Delete team' vs 'Permanently delete team' vs 'Remove team and all data'. which is clearest?
ben (PM): be explicit. 'Permanently delete team' for org-level teams + typed confirm field. for lightweight teams: confirm modal + undo toast is acceptable.
claire (DevEx): typed confirm needs clear label and error announcements; include instructions and make button disabled until match.
omar (Eng): backend supports a 14-day soft-delete retention for teams today, so copy should reflect that if we keep soft-delete. ben to confirm with legal.
maya (Design): suggested modal copy:
- Title: "Permanently delete team"
- Body: "This will permanently delete the team and all associated data. This action cannot be undone. To confirm, type the team name:"
- Input label: "Type team name to confirm"
- Actions: Primary: "Delete team" (danger, disabled until match). Secondary: "Cancel"
claire (DevEx): accessibility checklist: focus trap, aria-describedby for body, primary has aria-disabled until match, mismatch errors announced via role=alert. add keyboard walkthrough to QA.
ci-bot: note: branch 'feat/settings-validation-ux' created for review.
maya (Design): decision: use asterisk + sr-only for compact UIs, legend for long forms, step-level error summary with anchors for multi-step flows, and explicit 'Permanently delete team' modal with typed confirm for org-level deletes; undo toast for light deletes. i'll update the spec and Figma.
ben (PM): i'll update the product doc and confirm retention language with legal.
omar (Eng): leaving a note: keep validation batching to avoid perf spikes.
claire (DevEx): will add accessibility acceptance criteria to the ticket.
maya (Design): thanks all :thumbsup: will ping when spec is ready for handoff.
